name: CONICET Doctoral Fellowships
provider: Consejo Nacional de Investigaciones Cientificas y Tecnicas
summary: Doctoral fellowships for young Argentine and foreign university graduates pursuing a doctorate accredited by CONEAU. Fellows must dedicate themselves exclusively to research. Includes a monthly stipend that varies by location and occupational risk insurance.
amount: Monthly stipend varying by locality; see the official page
mobility: Doctorate must be CONEAU accredited, in Argentina.

deadline.note: Calls are published on the CONICET convocatorias site; see the official page

next_steps: Check open calls on convocatorias.conicet.gov.ar
Find a director and an accredited doctoral program

name: FWF ASTRA Awards
summary: Five-year grants for established postdocs in all disciplines, two to nine years after the doctorate, to consolidate independent careers in Austria. A lifetime limit of two applications applies.
amount: Basic grant of EUR 500,000 to 1 million, about EUR 1 million on average

deadline.note: Annual call with a final decision in June; see the official page for dates

next_steps: Check the FWF page for the next ASTRA call
Agree a host institution in Austria

name: FWF ESPRIT
summary: Three-year funding for postdoc-level researchers in all disciplines to lead their own project in Austria. Doctorate no more than five years old; a mentor in Austria is required, and applying from abroad is allowed.
amount: Principal investigator salary at the senior postdoc rate plus project costs of EUR 45,000, up to EUR 75,000 on request
mobility: No prior Austrian research experience is needed.

deadline.note: Submissions are continuous, with five approval meetings a year

next_steps: Find a mentor and host institution in Austria
Submit through the FWF elane portal

name: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships (via Australian Academy of Science)
summary: Postdoctoral fellowships for Australian researchers to do collaborative research with a Japanese host at a JSPS-affiliated institute for 12 to 24 months. PhD received on or after 2 April 2021.
amount: Monthly allowance of 362,000 yen, settling-in allowance of 200,000 yen, return airfare and travel insurance
mobility: Fellows must stay in Japan continuously and may not take other work.
next_steps: Agree a research plan with a Japanese host researcher
Read the JSPS guidelines on the Academy page

name: ARC Discovery Early Career Researcher Award
summary: Three-year awards for early career researchers in teaching and research or research-only positions. Funds the researcher's salary and on-costs plus project costs. The 2027 round has closed.
amount: Salary and on-costs, plus up to $50,000 per year in project costs, for three years

deadline.note: 2027 round closed 11 March 2026; results due 9 to 23 December 2026; no next round date on the page

next_steps: Check the current grant guidelines on GrantConnect
Contact the research office of an Australian university

name: ARC Discovery Projects
summary: Funding for individual researchers or teams to expand the knowledge base and research capacity in Australia. 2027 funding used a two-stage process, expression of interest then full application.
amount: $30,000 to $500,000 per year for up to 5 consecutive years

deadline.note: 2027 round closed 22 April 2026; announcement 14 to 28 January 2027; no next round date on the page

next_steps: Check the current grant guidelines on GrantConnect
Contact the research office of an Australian university

name: ARC Future Fellowships
summary: Four-year fellowships for outstanding mid-career researchers to be recruited and retained by universities in continuing academic positions. Encourages work in areas of national priority.
amount: Salary at one of 3 levels plus up to $60,000 per year project funding, for four years
next_steps: Check the Future Fellowships 2027 guidelines on GrantConnect
Contact the research office of an Australian university before the internal deadline

name: ARC Australian Laureate Fellowships
summary: Up to 17 five-year fellowships a year for world-class researchers and research leaders to conduct research in Australia. Includes two named fellowships for women researchers.
amount: Salary toward Professional Level E, 2 postdocs for 5 years, 2 postgraduate researchers for 4 years, and up to $300,000 per year project funding

deadline.note: 2027 round closed 30 April 2026; announcement 18 February to 4 March 2027; one call is made each year

next_steps: Check the Laureate Fellowships guidelines on GrantConnect
Contact the research office of an Australian university

name: ARC Mid-Career Industry Fellowships
summary: Supports academic researchers to build industry careers and industry researchers to work in universities, with time spent in both settings. Up to 25 fellowships a year when open, but the scheme is currently paused.
amount: Salary contribution for up to 4 years and project costs up to $290,000
mobility: Fellows must spend time undertaking research in both the university and industry setting.

deadline.note: Scheme paused pending the finalisation of the NCGP Policy Review

next_steps: Watch the ARC Grants Calendar for reopening
Contact a university research office

name: Australia Awards Scholarships
provider: Australian Government Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade
summary: Long-term awards for people from developing countries, particularly in the Indo-Pacific, to do full-time undergraduate or postgraduate study at participating Australian universities and TAFEs. Awardees are expected to contribute to development in their home country.
amount: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, living expenses contribution, health cover
mobility: Applicants must come from eligible partner countries and are expected to return home after study.

deadline.note: Opening and closing dates are set per country; see the official page

next_steps: Check whether your country participates on the official page
Read the country information and application dates

name: Churchill Fellowship
summary: A travel fellowship for Australians from any background to go overseas, learn from world leaders in their field and bring the knowledge home. No qualifications, title or specific profession are needed.
amount: See the official page
mobility: Fellows travel overseas to learn and then apply the knowledge in Australia.

deadline.note: 2026 round closed 30 April 2026; next round date not yet on the page

next_steps: Watch the Trust website and information sessions for the next round
Develop an idea that strengthens your field or community

name: CSIRO Postgraduate Scholarships
summary: Top-up scholarships of up to four years for doctoral students who hold or expect an RTP or equivalent award, plus some fully funded scholarships. Students are co-supervised by a university and CSIRO researcher on CSIRO priority areas.
amount: See the official page

deadline.note: See the CSIRO studentships page for current opportunities

next_steps: Check current CSIRO scholarship opportunities
Enrol or apply at an Australian university

name: Fulbright Australia scholarships
summary: Scholarships for Australians to study, research and collaborate in the United States, and for Americans to do the same in Australia. Awards cover postgraduate students, postdocs, professionals, scholars and distinguished chairs, with durations from 4 months to 2 years.
amount: Varies by award; see the official page
mobility: Australian citizens apply to hold awards in the United States.

deadline.note: Applications for 2027-2028 have closed; the page says to check back in February for 2028-2029 awards

next_steps: Review the available awards and your eligibility on the official page
Subscribe for the February opening

name: NHMRC Ideas Grants
provider: National Health and Medical Research Council
summary: Supports innovative research projects addressing a specific question, at all career stages, in any area of health and medical research from discovery to implementation. Not intended for projects where a clinical trial or cohort study is the primary objective.
amount: Based on assessment of the requested budget, for 1 to 5 years

deadline.note: 2026 round closed 6 May 2026; no next round date on the page

next_steps: Check the current Ideas Grants guidelines on GrantConnect
Contact your institution's research administration office

name: NHMRC Investigator Grants
provider: National Health and Medical Research Council
summary: Consolidated 5-year funding for the highest-performing health and medical researchers at all career stages, covering salary if required and a research support package. Flexible use across biomedical, clinical, public health and health services research.
amount: Salary (if required) plus a research support package; see the official page for level amounts

deadline.note: 2027 round closed 29 July 2026; outcomes expected March 2027; no next round date on the page

next_steps: Check the current Investigator Grants guidelines
Contact your institution's research administration office

name: Research Training Program (RTP) scholarships
summary: Australian Government funding to universities for research doctorate and research masters students, domestic and overseas. Scholarships can cover tuition fees, a living stipend and ancillary allowances. Applications go to each university, not to the Department.
amount: Tuition fee offset, stipend and allowances; 3 to 4 years for a full-time doctorate, up to 2 years for a research masters

deadline.note: Each university sets its own round and closing date

next_steps: Choose a university and read its RTP scholarship page
Contact a prospective supervisor before applying

name: Forrest Creative Fellowships
summary: Two-year fellowships at a Western Australian university for creative and performing arts practitioners to lead community research initiatives. Requires at least an Honours degree, a research project and three years of professional experience.
amount: Salary at Level A Step 8 (about $116,866 at UWA in 2026) plus 17% superannuation, plus accommodation allowance of $25,740 per year

deadline.note: Round typically opens in July and closes in August; applications open July 2027

next_steps: Subscribe to Foundation updates for the July opening
Plan a research project alongside your creative practice

name: Forrest Postdoctoral Fellowships
summary: Fellowships for early-stage postdoctoral researchers, in their final year of PhD or within two years of conferral, hosted at a Western Australian university. Open to all disciplines.
amount: Salary at Level A Step 8 (about $112,371 at UWA in 2026) plus 17% superannuation, accommodation allowance $25,740, and $12,000 research and travel allowance
mobility: Interstate and international Fellows can apply for a relocation allowance including an economy airfare to Perth.

deadline.note: Round typically opens mid to late May and closes in June; applications open May 2027

next_steps: Contact a prospective mentor at a WA university
Subscribe to Foundation updates for the May opening

name: Forrest PhD Scholarships
summary: PhD scholarships for exceptional candidates from any country and nationality, held at any of Western Australia's five universities in any subject area. The research must relate to Western Australia. Applicants must also apply for an RTP or equivalent scholarship.
amount: Package valued at over AU$270,000 over four years, including stipend, accommodation allowance and research and travel allowance
mobility: Scholars are based in Western Australia and live at Forrest Hall.
next_steps: Discuss your research plan with a prospective WA supervisor
Apply for an RTP scholarship at your chosen WA university

name: Westpac Future Leaders Scholarship
summary: Up to 17 scholarships a year for Australians starting a full-time masters or PhD at one of nine partner universities, combined with a nine-month leadership program and up to six months overseas.
amount: Up to $120,000 over 2 to 3 years
mobility: Study includes an overseas experience of up to six months.

deadline.note: 2027 round closed 20 August 2026; register interest for the next round

next_steps: Register your interest on the official page
Check the partner universities and priority areas

name: Westpac Research Fellowship
summary: Fellowships for early career researchers with a recent PhD, hosted at partner universities, for research on sustainability, technology and innovation, social change and Australia's relationship with Asia. Typically two are awarded each year.
amount: Minimum $460,000 over 3 to 5 years

deadline.note: 2027 expressions of interest closed 23 July 2026; register interest for future rounds

next_steps: Register your interest on the official page
Talk to the research office of a partner university

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship, Doctoral (CGRS D)
provider: CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC (Government of Canada)
summary: Supports doctoral students at Canadian institutions, with up to 15% of awards open to international applicants registered in an eligible Canadian doctoral program. It replaces the Vanier program, whose page no longer accepts applications.
amount: CAD 40,000 per year for 36 months
mobility: Up to 20% of awards may be held at a non-Canadian institution, for Canadian citizens, permanent residents or protected persons with a prior Canadian degree.

deadline.note: The agency deadline was 17 October (8:00 pm ET); the next date is not on the page, and institutions set earlier internal deadlines

next_steps: Ask your Canadian university graduate office about its internal deadline
Pick the agency (CIHR, NSERC or SSHRC) that fits your field

name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship, Master's (CGRS M)
provider: CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC (Government of Canada)
summary: Funds a research-oriented master's or doctoral program at a Canadian institution with an allocation. You need 0 to 12 months of full-time study by 31 December of the application year, and applications go through the institution.
amount: CAD 27,000 for 12 months
mobility: Tenable only at eligible Canadian institutions.
next_steps: Contact the graduate studies office of your target Canadian university first
Apply through the Research Portal before 1 December, 8:00 pm ET

name: Canada Postdoctoral Research Award (CPRA)
provider: CIHR, NSERC and SSHRC (Government of Canada)
summary: Funds postdoctoral research for people who finished their doctorate no more than three years before 1 September of the application year. Up to 20% of awards go to international applicants who studied or work at a Canadian institution.
amount: CAD 70,000 per year for 24 months
mobility: Holding the award outside Canada (up to 30% of awards) needs Canadian citizenship, permanent residence or protected status and a Canadian doctorate.

deadline.note: Round closed: CIHR 16 September, SSHRC 10 September, NSERC 17 October; next dates not on the page

next_steps: Choose CIHR, NSERC or SSHRC by your research field
Check for an earlier institutional deadline and line up referees

name: Canada Research Chairs
provider: Canada Research Chairs Program (CIHR, NSERC, SSHRC)
summary: Tier 1 chairs go to established world-leading researchers (seven years, renewable once); Tier 2 to exceptional emerging researchers (five years, renewable once). Eligible Canadian degree-granting institutions nominate the candidates.
amount: Tier 1 CAD 200,000 per year; Tier 2 CAD 100,000 per year plus CAD 20,000 yearly stipend for first-term chairs

deadline.note: Institutions nominate candidates for their allocated chairs; no fixed national date

next_steps: Ask a Canadian university research office about open chair allocations
Prepare a nomination that fits the institution's strategic research plan

name: Mitacs Accelerate
summary: Research internships of 4 or 6 months linking a student, postdoc or recent graduate with an academic supervisor and a partner organization in Canada. The partner adds funds and Mitacs adds a research award.
amount: Standard model: partner CAD 7,500 plus Mitacs CAD 15,000 per internship; postdoc model CAD 20,000
next_steps: Find a Canadian partner organization and an eligible academic supervisor
Contact a Mitacs Advisor to confirm current intake

name: Mitacs Globalink Research Award
summary: Funds research projects of 12 to 48 weeks between Canada and other countries for senior undergraduates, graduate students and postdocs. Needs a home and a host supervisor. Each person may hold at most two units in a lifetime.
amount: CAD 6,000 per 12 to 24 week unit; CAD 12,000 for 24 to 48 weeks
mobility: Interns cannot research in their country of citizenship or where they earned a degree; outbound travel is not allowed to countries under Canadian avoid-travel advisories.
next_steps: Agree a project with a home and a host supervisor at eligible universities
Submit 12 to 16 weeks before the planned start

name: NSERC Discovery Grants (Individual)
summary: Long-term operating funds for ongoing research programs in the natural sciences and engineering (excluding health), held by university faculty. Up to five years, and the grant does not cover the full cost of a program.
amount: See the official page (no dollar cap listed; five-year budget required)
next_steps: Confirm you meet NSERC individual eligibility as university faculty
Submit the full application with the NSERC Canadian Common CV by 2 November, 8:00 pm ET

name: SSHRC Insight Grants
summary: Supports research excellence in the social sciences and humanities for emerging and established scholars, over 2 to 5 years. Stream A and Stream B cover different budget ranges.
amount: Stream A CAD 10,000 to 125,000; Stream B CAD 125,001 to 500,000

deadline.note: The October 2026 competition closed on 1 October; next date not on the page

next_steps: Read the competition page for applicant and co-applicant rules
Plan the application with your university research office

name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Scholarship
summary: Doctoral scholarship for humanities and social sciences students in the first or second year of a PhD, whose research fits one of four themes. Needs three reference letters.
amount: See the official page
mobility: Canadian students may study in Canada or abroad; international students must be enrolled at a Canadian university.
next_steps: Check your research fits one of the four Foundation themes
Request three reference letters before 6 November, 5:00 pm ET

name: Branco Weiss Fellowship
summary: Up to five years of support for postdocs without a faculty position to pursue unconventional projects in natural sciences, engineering, social sciences or humanities, anywhere in the world. PhD must be held by 15 January 2027 and be no more than five years old.
amount: Up to CHF 600,000 over up to five years
next_steps: Choose a mentor who supports only you
Check the eligibility page

name: SNSF Ambizione
summary: Funds early-career researchers to lead their own project at a Swiss higher education institution for up to four years, within four years of the PhD. Covers salary plus project funds, or project funds only. The 2026 call is the final Ambizione deadline in this form.
amount: See the official page
mobility: Applicants need a Swiss link: Swiss nationality, a Swiss degree, or at least 12 months of research at a Swiss institution after the doctorate.
next_steps: Get a written confirmation letter from a Swiss host institution
Submit in the SNSF portal by 3 November 2026, 17:00 CET

name: SNSF Postdoc.Mobility
summary: Fellowships for postdocs to research abroad, normally 24 months, with a subsistence grant, travel allowance and possible research costs, plus an optional return grant (3 to 12 months) in Switzerland. Apply up to 3 years after the doctorate. Final deadline is in August 2027, before a new scheme from 2028.
amount: See the official page
mobility: A stay at the institution where you earned your bachelor's, master's or PhD is not formally allowed; applicants need a Swiss link (citizen, C-permit, or Swiss degree).
next_steps: Check the Swiss link requirement on the official page
Find a host abroad and apply before 2 February 2027

name: SNSF Starting Grants
summary: Up to 1 million CHF over five years for researchers to lead an independent project and a team in Switzerland. Applicants need a doctorate plus several years of independent post-PhD research, and must not already lead a group of about 2 to 3 people. Eccellenza is closed and replaced by this scheme.
amount: Up to 1 million CHF over five years
mobility: A Swiss link is required: at least two years of research in Switzerland at 0.8 FTE or more.
next_steps: Check the call document for the eligibility window
Get a host confirmation letter guaranteeing an assistant professorship or group leader position

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
summary: Research scholarships for early career researchers from abroad holding a Master's degree, to do doctoral or postdoctoral research at a Swiss university, university of applied sciences, ETH Zurich, EPFL or ETH Domain institute. Art scholarships cover an initial Master's in Switzerland. Maximum age 35.
amount: 2,450 CHF per month
mobility: Open to applicants from 183 countries who apply through the Swiss diplomatic representation; a Swiss academic supervisor must back the application.

deadline.note: Annual; applications for 2027-2028 opened 20 August 2026 with country-specific deadlines. See the official page

next_steps: Check whether your country is eligible and the national deadline
Secure a Swiss academic supervisor

name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
provider: Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students
summary: Research scholarships for early career researchers from 183 countries who hold a master's, at Swiss universities, ETH Zurich, EPFL or ETH Domain institutes, plus art scholarships for master's students. Needs a Swiss academic supervisor.
amount: CHF 2,450 per month

deadline.note: Applications opened 20 August 2026; deadlines are set per country and not given on the page.

next_steps: Check your country's deadline and availability
Secure a Swiss supervisor

name: Schwarzman Scholars
summary: Master's programme in China to prepare future leaders and deepen understanding between China and the rest of the world. Needs an undergraduate degree, age 18 to 28 on 1 August of the enrolment year, and strong English.
amount: See the official page; coverage not stated on the page read

deadline.note: Next class begins August 2028; applications open April to September 2027 (March to May 2027 for Chinese citizens).

next_steps: Check the FAQ for coverage
Prepare for the 2027 application window

name: DAAD Research Grants: One-Year and Short-Term Grants for Doctoral Candidates and Postdocs
summary: For doctoral candidates doing their doctorate outside Germany (2 to 12 months) and postdocs (2 to 6 months) to do research in Germany. Pays 1,400 euros per month plus insurance, travel allowance and a research allowance of 460 euros for stays over 6 months.
amount: 1,400 euros per month plus allowances
mobility: Not open to those doing their entire doctorate at a German university or living in Germany for more than 15 months at the deadline.

summary: Funds early-career researchers in all disciplines to lead an independent junior research group for 6 years, to qualify for a university professorship. amount: See the official page
mobility: Applicants from abroad must plan to continue their research careers in Germany after funding ends and attach a letter of intent.
next_steps: Read the current call on the official page
Ask a host institution to sponsor the application

name: DFG Heisenberg Programme
summary: For researchers in all disciplines who have completed habilitation or an equivalent qualification and have an outstanding research record. Funding of up to five years is offered as a professorship, position, clinician substitute position or fellowship.
amount: See the official page
mobility: You may continue research at an institution of your choice; tenure-track professors in Germany and those in permanent posts comparable to W2/W3 cannot apply.
next_steps: Read the current call on the official page
Ask a host institution to sponsor the application

name: DFG Walter Benjamin Programme
summary: Enables early-career postdoctoral researchers to carry out their own project in Germany or abroad, normally for up to two years. The programme generally requires changing research institution, and the host may not be a for-profit entity.
amount: See the official page (monthly fellowship rates plus allowances)
mobility: For a fellowship abroad, the applicant needs at least three continuous years as a researcher in Germany just before applying, or most schooling and higher education in Germany.

summary: Research stays in Germany of 6 to 24 months for postdocs (PhD within 4 years) or 6 to 18 months for experienced researchers (PhD within 12 years), with a host chosen by the applicant. Non-German nationals.

Apply as soon as the call opens

Submit before the 29 January 2027 deadline

name: Ramon y Cajal Contracts
summary: Research contracts bringing Spanish and foreign researchers with a strong track record into Spanish research organisations, to reach a stable position in the Spanish system. Doctorate obtained 2015 to 2023 in the 2025 call.
amount: Call budget EUR 132,346,140; no per-contract amount on the page

deadline.note: The 2025 call closed 11 December 2025; calls recur yearly, see the official page
